subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should `openclaw agent` change its default behavior after an accepted Gateway disconnect from immediate isolated embedded fallback to reattach-first wait-and-replay recovery?
rationale: This is an intentional user-visible availability, latency, output, and duplicate-side-effect tradeoff; source review cannot decide which failure mode OpenClaw should promise by default.

options.title: Approve reattach-first
options.body: Adopt Gateway recovery before fallback, define the public CLI and protocol contract, and require final-head real behavior proof for each terminal outcome.

options.title: Keep current fallback policy
options.body: Retain the current isolated embedded fallback as the default and close or narrow this branch to non-policy-compatible fixes only.

options.title: Split by invocation mode
options.body: Use a documented mode-specific policy only if maintainers want different behavior for delivery-oriented and interactive CLI runs.

recommendation.title: Approve reattach-first
recommendation.body: Adopt Gateway recovery before fallback, define the public CLI and protocol contract, and require final-head real behavior proof for each terminal outcome.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged current-main fallback containment establishes the adjacent behavior whose public policy this PR would change.
